purpose: Correct the known writing-grader false negatives without modifying the published historical artifacts.
scope_caveat: This is a targeted overlay for the independently reproduced writing-grader defect, not a rewrite of the historical campaign. The historical raw totals remain preserved. Other families retain their published verdicts unless separately regraded and audited.
comparison_caveat: DeepSeek N=3 and Qwen N=10 have different sample sizes and model-specific sampling configurations. Corrected pass fractions are directional quality evidence, not a claim of statistical equivalence.
